name: goal-ring
title: Goal Ring
description: How far today is toward a daily goal: a ring that fills as points come in, the count in its middle, and a check once the goal is met. It is a `meter`, so assistive tech reads "15 of 20 XP" without the ring.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/goal-ring

Installed to `components/ui/games/goal-ring.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/goal-ring';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/goal-ring
